# Design System

> Lilian's personal design system: DTCG design tokens, Angular + Tailwind CSS
> v4 components (copy-in, shadcn-style), and AI agent integrations. This file
> helps AI agents discover and consume the system.

## Docs

- [DESIGN.md](https://lilieon.github.io/design-system/DESIGN.md): the visual
  language — rules, principles and semantic tokens. Read this before building UI.
- [Component catalog (Storybook)](https://lilieon.github.io/design-system/):
  live component documentation.

## Components

Installable through the shadcn registry. Each component is a plain Angular
standalone component source file, copied into your project.

- [Registry index](https://lilieon.github.io/design-system/registry/index.json)
- Example: `npx shadcn add https://lilieon.github.io/design-system/registry/button.json`
- Available: alert, badge, button, card, input, label

## Tokens

- [tokens.css](https://lilieon.github.io/design-system/tokens.css): CSS custom
  properties (`:root` light, `.dark` dark)
- [tailwind-theme.css](https://lilieon.github.io/design-system/tailwind-theme.css):
  Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme inline` mapping
- Source of truth: DTCG JSON at
  [github.com/Lilieon/design-system](https://github.com/Lilieon/design-system)
  (`tokens/`)
